description.Superman (Clark Kent): The last son of Krypton, raised in Kansas, a symbol of hope for humanity.
description.Superman (Jon Kent): Biological son of Superman and Lois Lane, future bearer of the mantle.

description.Wonder Woman: Immortal Amazon princess, warrior and ambassador of peace.
description.Flash (Barry Allen): The fastest man alive, connected to the Speed Force.

description.Aquaman: King of Atlantis, half human and half Atlantean, protector of the oceans.

description.Nightwing: The first Robin, a born acrobat, now grown up and a hero in his own right.

description.Starfire: Tamaranean princess able to absorb and project solar energy.

description.Black Lightning: High school teacher who controls electricity.
